diaries.text: Day 1: All bribe offers to the Police Chief were refused, signaling a high risk of inspections. To remain safe and build stability, I chose to commit no crimes today and have agreed to respect the turf deal with the Families. I am focusing on observing the current political climate in Tidewall before attempting any aggressive expansion or illicit activities. The treasury remains stable, and I look forward to seeing how the city responds to this quiet start.

The Saltdogs proposed mutual respect for the turf war, which we accepted in the hopes of building stability. The Council is threatening audits, so we must be careful with our financial maneuvers. Looking forward to seeing the results of today's actions and adjusting our strategy for tomorrow.

The World has no score; I report what the events say and nothing more. Watching for whether this mutual respect repeats, and whether either gang starts encroaching later in the game.

In light of the high risk of inspection and the Council's explicit threat of audits, we have decided to refrain from all criminal activity in our districts today to preserve our capital. We maintain our commitment to the turf truce with the Saltdogs, choosing respect to keep stability in our neighborhoods. We will wait for the situation to de-escalate before resuming any profitable ventures.
